messages:
jess: quick Q — where's the best spot to pull a 24h correlation view for SM% vs GPU memory vs KV-cache hitrate and batch size across pools? trying to debug a noisy pod (lots of evictions).
konrad: grafana has a heatmap dashboard, search for `GPU throughput / KV-batch heatmap` (uid: rw-gpu-overview). panel id 8123 shows SM% vs batchsize distribution.
miguel: link: https://grafana.internal/rw-gpu-overview?orgId=1&from=now-24h&to=now&viewPanel=8123 — set ?var-pool=prod-sm-1 to scope to a pool.
ryan: for traces, Jaeger service `runtime-infer` + operation `kv_lookup` is useful. filter by tag `pool=prod-sm-1` and span duration > 50ms.
jess: perfect, ty. any quick Loki queries for the eviction logs? I want to see timestamps + keys evicted.
miguel: Loki snippet I run:
```
{app="runtime", pool="prod-sm-1"} |= "evict" | json | line_format "${time} ${msg}"
```
this shows eviction events + mem pressure logs.
ellen: pinging @eng-runtime-oncall in case this is an incident, but sounds like a perf/regression not a full outage :thinking_face:
deploy-bot: PR #4321 merged — `kvcache_evictions_warn` adjusted from 75/min -> 50/min. changelog: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/4321 :white_check_mark:
konrad: fyi if you're hunting batching issues, compare `batch_size` histogram panel next to the heatmap. also add `$pool` var so you can flip pools quickly.
ryan: quick Jaeger tip: look at traces where `kv_miss=true` — those often correlate with higher token latencies. cat the top slow traces and check parent span for batching delays.
jess: who owns prod-sm-1? need an owner to post findings and decide on alert tweaks.
miguel: owner is infra-ml (miguel). I'll take this and add findings to the incident doc. will paste dashboard links + queries.
ryan: small alert suggestion snippet to start a PR:
```
alert: KVCACHE_EvictionsHigh
expr: increase(kvcache_evictions_total[5m]) > 50
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "kvcache evictions > 50/min on {{ $labels.pool }}"
```
konrad: +1 to lowering threshold, but let's watch for noise. maybe require 2/3 pools or a sustained window before paging.
jess: ok i'll add a short checklist in the doc: 1) screenshots of panel 8123 + batch histogram 2) Loki query results 3) 3 slow Jaeger traces 4) proposed alert PR link 5) owner next steps.
miguel: I'll drop screenshots and the Loki queries in 10-15m. :thumbsup:
ellen: thanks all — if you want ops help for running a targeted replay test, ping me and I can allocate a small canary pool.
jess: awesome, will follow up in the doc. closing this thread for now, will re-open if more infra-level action needed. :raised_hands:
